title: How to build a printer
summary: A technical tutorial by Nishant Joshi about building a 3D printer from scratch, following the popular 'build your own X' genre. The article covers hardware assembly, electronics, firmware configuration, and practical implementation of FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling) printing technology.
problem_solved: Provides a comprehensive guide for makers to build their own 3D printer, enabling customization and cost savings compared to commercial options.
why_valuable: democratizes manufacturing technology by showing how to build functional 3D printing hardware from components, fostering deeper understanding of precision mechanics and embedded systems.
